Describes insert-row bisection, script-goal parsing via new Function/acorn rather than node --check alone, and the ModuleLoader.load factory with package id, host React via require, and apply/inject exports.

Uses the boot and restart evidence to explain boot-time combo assembly, required full host restarts, Windows tree-kill for retained ports, refresh verification, and EADDRINUSE as an old process retaining the socket.

Proposes per-plugin classic-script validation and better culprit attribution, plus an author checklist covering loader factory, host React, inject/apply, deferred slot usage conceptually, and restart/Windows cleanup.
